rationale: Chest pain with cold sweat, near-syncope and inability to stand: signs of shock; needs immediate life-saving intervention.
Anaphylaxis with airway involvement: immediate adrenaline/airway intervention.
Drug reaction with wheeze and breathing difficulty (anaphylaxis): immediate intervention.
Severe respiratory distress (speaks only a few words): immediate airway/breathing support.
Large haematemesis with palpitations, cold skin, near-syncope: haemorrhagic shock signs; immediate resuscitation.
Suspected heat stroke (hyperthermia + confusion): immediate cooling is life-saving.
Possible acute coronary syndrome in a 60-year-old with hypertension: high-risk situation.
Chest pain with palpitations and dizziness: high risk (arrhythmia/ACS).
Acute stroke symptoms within the treatment window: high risk.
Thunderclap headache with neck stiffness and photophobia (possible subarachnoid haemorrhage/meningitis): high risk.
Severe pain (9/10) with missed period and bleeding: possible ectopic pregnancy; high risk / severe pain.
Chest pressure in a person with diabetes (atypical ACS presentation), visible chest-holding despite minimising: high risk.
Stable, moderate pain; likely labs + imaging (possible appendicitis): 2+ resources.
Vomiting and fever with poor intake: labs + IV fluids (2+ resources); no instability described.
Possible pneumonia: chest X-ray + labs (2+ resources); no distress described.
Possible dengue: blood tests (repeat CBC) and possibly IV fluids: 2+ resources.
Ankle X-ray + wound repair/care and analgesia: 2 resources.
Abdominal pain with fever: labs ± imaging (2+ resources) despite minimising.
Likely uncomplicated UTI: urinalysis only (1 resource).
Mild allergic reaction without airway or breathing involvement: one medication by injection or observation (1 resource).
Mild lower abdominal pain with dysuria: urinalysis (1 resource).
Wrist injury: X-ray (1 resource).
Fever with sore throat, eating well: throat test or one lab (1 resource).
Gaping 2 cm laceration: simple repair (1 resource).
Prescription refill: no resources.
Mild tension-type headache without red flags; oral medication only (not a resource).
Mild sunburn: advice and oral analgesia only (no resources).
Common cold symptoms: no resources.
Alcohol flush reaction without symptoms: advice only (no resources).
Mild viral illness: oral medication and advice (no resources).
